input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble with my mobile data—it either stops working or is extremely slow. I really need to get excellent internet speed on my phone, especially since I don’t have access to Wi-Fi right now. Can you help me fix this?
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information to verify my account.
I’m using the phone number 555-123-2002, and that’s the line having the mobile data issues. Please let me know what you need me to do next!

I’m sure the number I’m using is 555-123-2002. That’s the one I use for all my calls, texts, and mobile data. Could you please double-check on your end? If you need me to verify anything else or provide more details, just let me know!

Yes, please go ahead and run the diagnostic checks on my phone’s network status and data settings. Let me know if you need me to do anything on my end or if you need any specific information from my device.

Based on my phone’s status bar, it looks like Airplane Mode is currently enabled. Would you like me to turn off Airplane Mode so we can continue with the diagnostic checks? Also, if you need to know the specific device model or operating system, please let me know how I can find that information for you.
I’ve turned off Airplane Mode on my phone. I can see that mobile data is enabled now, but the signal shows as “Poor” and it’s currently connected to 2G. What would you like me to do next?

I’ve changed my network mode preference to “4G/5G preferred.” My phone now shows an excellent signal and is connected to 5G with mobile data enabled. What should I do next to check if my internet speed is excellent?

I tried running a speed test, but it failed and said “No Connection.” Even though my phone shows an excellent 5G signal and data is enabled, it seems like the internet still isn’t working. What should I do next?
I checked, and Data Saver mode is currently OFF on my phone. What would you like me to try next to get my internet working?
I checked, and there’s no VPN connected on my phone right now. What should I try next to get my mobile data working?

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to “internet” with the MMSC URL as “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Everything looks standard to me. Would you still like me to reset the APN settings to default and reboot the device, or is there something else I should try first?

I reset the APN settings to default and rebooted my phone, but when I tried the speed test again, it still failed and said “No Connection.” My phone still shows an excellent 5G signal with data enabled. What should I try next? This is getting a bit frustrating.

instructions.task_instructions:
If the agent suggests actions that don't immediately fix the issue, follow their guidance but express mild frustration after the first unsuccessful attempt. You will consider the issue resolved only when speed test returns excellent internet speed and nothing else. If it returns poor, fair or good, you will not consider the issue resolved. You are willing to refuel 2.0 GB of data if necessary, but you do not want to change your mobile data plan. If the tool call does not return updated status information, you might need to perform another tool call to get the updated status. 
Whenever the agent asks you about your device, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls. 
For example: If the agent asks what the status bar shows, always ground your response on the results of the `get_status_bar` tool call. If the agent asks if you are able to send an MMS message, always ground your response on the results of the `can_send_mms` tool call.
Never make up the results of tool calls, always ground your responses on the results of tool calls.
If you are unsure about whether an action is necessary, always ask the agent for clarification.
